mapper.select: SELECT DRAWING_ID, IMAGE_SEQ, FROM_ROW_NO, FROM_ROW_OFFSET, FROM_COLUMN_NO, FROM_COLUMN_OFFSET, TO_ROW_NO, TO_ROW_OFFSET, TO_COLUMN_NO, TO_COLUMN_OFFSET, ANCHOR_TYPE, Z_ORDER, DRAWING_EXTRA FROM wo_sheet_drawing_line WHERE SHEET_SEQ = #{sheetSeq} AND DEL_DATETIME IS NULL ORDER BY Z_ORDER, DRAWING_ID

insert.foreach: MERGE INTO wo_sheet_drawing_line T USING (SELECT CAST(#{sheetSeq} AS BIGINT) AS SHEET_SEQ, CAST(#{d.drawingId} AS VARCHAR) AS DRAWING_ID) S ON (T.SHEET_SEQ = S.SHEET_SEQ AND T.DRAWING_ID = S.DRAWING_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET IMAGE_SEQ = #{d.imageSeq}, FROM_ROW_NO = #{d.fromRowNo}, FROM_ROW_OFFSET = #{d.fromRowOffset}, FROM_COLUMN_NO = #{d.fromColumnNo}, FROM_COLUMN_OFFSET = #{d.fromColumnOffset}, TO_ROW_NO = #{d.toRowNo}, TO_ROW_OFFSET = #{d.toRowOffset}, TO_COLUMN_NO = #{d.toColumnNo}, TO_COLUMN_OFFSET = #{d.toColumnOffset}, ANCHOR_TYPE = #{d.anchorType}, Z_ORDER = #{d.zOrder}, DRAWING_EXTRA = #{d.drawingExtra}, MOD_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, MOD_USER = #{userKey}, DEL_DATETIME = NULL, DEL_USER = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SHEET_SEQ, DRAWING_ID, IMAGE_SEQ, FROM_ROW_NO, FROM_ROW_OFFSET, FROM_COLUMN_NO, FROM_COLUMN_OFFSET, TO_ROW_NO, TO_ROW_OFFSET, TO_COLUMN_NO, TO_COLUMN_OFFSET, ANCHOR_TYPE, Z_ORDER, DRAWING_EXTRA, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES ( #{sheetSeq}, #{d.drawingId}, #{d.imageSeq}, #{d.fromRowNo}, #{d.fromRowOffset}, #{d.fromColumnNo}, #{d.fromColumnOffset}, #{d.toRowNo}, #{d.toRowOffset}, #{d.toColumnNo}, #{d.toColumnOffset}, #{d.anchorType}, #{d.zOrder}, #{d.drawingExtra}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey} )

mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wo_sheet_drawing_line ( SHEET_SEQ, DRAWING_ID, IMAGE_SEQ, FROM_ROW_NO, FROM_ROW_OFFSET, FROM_COLUMN_NO, FROM_COLUMN_OFFSET, TO_ROW_NO, TO_ROW_OFFSET, TO_COLUMN_NO, TO_COLUMN_OFFSET, ANCHOR_TYPE, Z_ORDER, DRAWING_EXTRA, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES
(#{sheetSeq}, #{d.drawingId}, #{d.imageSeq}, #{d.fromRowNo}, #{d.fromRowOffset}, #{d.fromColumnNo}, #{d.fromColumnOffset}, #{d.toRowNo}, #{d.toRowOffset}, #{d.toColumnNo}, #{d.toColumnOffset}, #{d.anchorType}, #{d.zOrder}, CAST(#{d.drawingExtra} AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey})
ON CONFLICT (SHEET_SEQ, DRAWING_ID) DO UPDATE SET IMAGE_SEQ = EXCLUDED.IMAGE_SEQ, FROM_ROW_NO = EXCLUDED.FROM_ROW_NO, FROM_ROW_OFFSET = EXCLUDED.FROM_ROW_OFFSET, FROM_COLUMN_NO = EXCLUDED.FROM_COLUMN_NO, FROM_COLUMN_OFFSET = EXCLUDED.FROM_COLUMN_OFFSET, TO_ROW_NO = EXCLUDED.TO_ROW_NO, TO_ROW_OFFSET = EXCLUDED.TO_ROW_OFFSET, TO_COLUMN_NO = EXCLUDED.TO_COLUMN_NO, TO_COLUMN_OFFSET = EXCLUDED.TO_COLUMN_OFFSET, ANCHOR_TYPE = EXCLUDED.ANCHOR_TYPE, Z_ORDER = EXCLUDED.Z_ORDER, DRAWING_EXTRA = EXCLUDED.DRAWING_EXTRA, MOD_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, MOD_USER = #{userKey}, DEL_DATETIME = NULL, DEL_USER = NULL
